translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

book.name: ISAÍAS
book.title: A Slolonel Dios D'a Vin̈aj ISAÍAS

content.text: Ex aj Sion schon̈ab' Dios, aq'uequel e vayan̈, q'uean̈ec vaan, tec'b'ejec e b'a. Ch'oxequel svach'il eyilji, yujto man̈xa b'aq'uin̈ ol jax eb' ch'oc nacional ch'oc sdiosal yac' chucal d'ayex.
Q'uean̈ec vaan ex aj Jerusalén, maq'uequel pococ d'ayex, ol ex emxoc c'ojan d'a e despacho eyac'an yajalil. Ex aj Sion, ex ix ex xid'ec' d'a ch'oc nacional, iq'uequel tas tzec'b'iloch d'a e jaj.
A Jehová Cajal tz'alan icha tic: Malaj val jab'oc tumin ix in cha d'a e patic ayic ix ex ic'chajb'at checab'oc. An̈ejtona', malaj pax tumin ol vac'a' yic tzex vic'anxi meltzajoc.
A in chon̈ab' tic, b'atnac d'a Egipto d'a peca', ch'oc chon̈ab'il ajnac yec' eb' ta'. Axo ticnaic ix ixtaj eb' yuj eb' aj Asiria, vach'chom malaj jab'oc yuuj.
Axo ticnaic, ¿tas smoj tzin c'ulej? D'a ichn̈ej ta' ix ic'jib'at in chon̈ab' tic d'a Babilonia. A eb' tz'ac'an yajalil d'a yib'an̈ eb', syic'chaan̈ sb'a eb', max yactej eb' in sb'uchani.
Yuj chi', ol c'och sc'ual, ol yojtaquejel in chon̈ab' tic to Dios in, ol nachajel yuj eb' to a in ix in lolon d'a eb', xchi Jehová.

Jantac svach'il quilan d'a tzalquixtac, ayic sjavi junoc mach tz'alan vach' ab'ix. Yed'nac yab'ixal junc'olal, syalanpax yab'ixal colnab'il, syalan icha tic: Ex aj Sion, a e Diosal van yoch Reyal, xchi.
Ab'ec, a eb' stan̈vumal e chon̈ab', tz'el yav eb', jun lajan tz'aj sq'ue n̈ilnaj eb' yel yav yuj tzalajc'olal, yujto syil val eb' sjax Jehová d'a Sion.
Ex aj Jerusalén juvinaccan e chon̈ab', elocab' eyav e b'itan d'a tzalajc'olal, yujto ol oc'xoc sc'ol Jehová d'ayex, ol scolanxi Jerusalén.
Yujto ol sch'ox spoder Jehová yil juntzan̈xo nación. Masanil anima d'a yolyib'an̈q'uinal tic, ol yojtaquejel eb' to a Dios on̈ colanxi.
Elan̈ec, elan̈ecta d'a yol sc'ab' eb' aj Babilonia. A ex eyed'nac yamc'ab' yic stemplo Jehová, man̈ eyam tas man̈ vach'oc, man̈ eyac'b'at e b'a d'a scal chucal.
Man̈ sc'ac'aliloc, man̈ elelaloc ol ex elta, yujto a Jehová co Diosal ol oymaj d'a e patictac, ol ex stan̈vani.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tic: A jun in Checab' tic vach'n̈ej ol elc'ochoc, ol ic'joc val chaan̈, ol b'inaj val.
Tzijtum mach ol sat sc'ol yilani, yujto ol ixtax yilji, man̈xo animaoc ol aj yilji yuj tas ol utajoc.
Icha pax chi' jantac nación, ol sat sc'ol yilani ayic ol ic'jocchaan̈. A eb' rey toxon̈ej ol och q'uelan eb', yujto ol yil eb', ol nachajel yuj eb' tas to manta b'aj ix yab' eb' yalji, xchi Jehová.
